senses.gloss: ch. same, slight suspicion of idolatrous manipulation of wine (v. נֶסֵךְ).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 31b:8">Ab. Zar. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>חמרא משום ש׳ וכ׳</he> wine (he refused to drink) because of a suspicion, but why did he refuse beer? <he>משום ש׳ דש׳</he> because of a suspicion of a suspicion (it might be suspected to be wine).—V. <cite ref="U01523">next w.</cite>
